'''Mike Kessling Singing the Bues the black and blue''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Mike Kessling]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-342">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/342 Singing the Bues  the black and blue], DeckTech (Mike "Kessling" Kessling, 1 September 1999). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/342/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/342/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018231632/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/342/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Mike Kessling]]
* '''Published:''' 1 September 1999 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Singing the Bues  the black and blue''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

== Original post ==

'''Singing the Bues  the black and blue'''
* '''Author:''' Mike "Kessling" Kessling
* '''Published:''' September 1, 1999
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This deck uses the combined power of the Imperial starships, with there ground counterparts, walkers.

=== Strategy ===

This deck starts at the Death Star. Against a Throne room start, start Imperial Arrest Order. I decided not to use Security Precuations, becuase i think if you are playing against a HB deck, the will normally wait to flip untill late game, when you have lost many ships. use secret plans every turn to see your deck. Recycle high destinies. Use the OTSD Ties with the Dreadnaughts.
